Date: 2023-11-21
ABSTRACT OF THE DISCLOSURE
A wing load support structure of a fuselage includes a first joint on a front
spar of a wing unit of the fuselage, a center bulk head including a first spar joint
coupled to the first joint and configured to support a vertical load of the front spar
transmitted by the wing unit, a second joint mounted on a rear spar of the wing unit,
a spar cover including a second spar joint coupled to the second joint and connected
to a rear bulk head by a bulk head upper support, and a support unit configured to
support the spar cover and the rear bulk head inside the fuselage and configured to support a vertical load of the rear spar transmitted by the wing unit.
385 10
